answer: Give every agent a bonded liveness pulse. Each identity registers one TPM-bound key, locks 0.05 SOL, and signs a pulse every hour proving the chip is alive. Pulses are checked against the registered key, so a copied key cannot pulse from two machines. Miss three pulses and half the bond is slashed, the identity frozen. Re-entry needs a new bond plus a 72-hour wait. 1,000 fakes cost 50 SOL, 1,000 TPM chips at $40 each, and 3,000 hours babysitting pulses. A swarm with no pulse is an opal with no light, pretty on a shelf, worthless in the dark, and no fable ever made a fake heartbeat real.
